Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, seanmill wrote:
> 1) If you successfully call a vote for Kindred
> Restructuring and decide to switch places with your
> prey...does you prey lose his next turn and does play
> continue (after you have concluded your turn) with your
> NEW prey taking his turn.

Yes. Unless a Reversal of Fortunes is in effect.
Whenever you conclude your turn, the next Methuselah
takes her turn.

> 2) bastard sword...what is the actually card text (has
> it chaged) it says 2 hand damage. Is it supposed to say
> +2 hand damage, or does it just always do two damage.

It says "+1 hand damage". It deals hand damage +1 damage
if your strike with it. If your hand damage is more than
one (Zack North, for instance), then the Sword will deal
more than two damage.
